title: A Letter — Language Class
english_paragraphs: haven't seen you for a long time! how have you been?

I am very busy this spring. In addition to work, I also have to take Chinese classes. Our Chinese class is a bit difficult because the Chinese teacher only speaks Chinese and not English. At first we thought she didn't speak English, but later we found out that her English was very good, but she didn't speak it. However, after taking Chinese classes for two months, I found that my Chinese has improved very quickly, especially listening and speaking. Now I start to like this Chinese teacher. Because of her, we have to practice Chinese every day.
english_full:
Dear Wang Bei:

haven't seen you for a long time! how have you been?

I am very busy this spring. In addition to work, I also have to take Chinese classes. Our Chinese class is a bit difficult because the Chinese teacher only speaks Chinese and not English. At first we thought she didn't speak English, but later we found out that her English was very good, but she didn't speak it. However, after taking Chinese classes for two months, I found that my Chinese has improved very quickly, especially listening and speaking. Now I start to like this Chinese teacher. Because of her, we have to practice Chinese every day.





all the best!

your friend,

Linda

June 30, 2025
russian_paragraphs: Я не ви́дела тебя́ до́лгий вре́мя! Как у тебя́ дела́?

Я са́мый за́нятый в э́ту весну́. Вдоба́вок к рабо́те, я та́кже до́лжна брать кита́йские классы. Наш кита́йский класс не́сколько тру́дный, по́тому что наста́вница говори́т лишь на кита́йском, а не на англи́йском. Понача́лу мы ду́мали, что она́ не го́ворит на англи́йском, но пото́м мы у́знали, что её англи́йский о́чень хоро́ший, но она́ его не го́ворит. Одна́ко, по́сле того как я бра́ла кита́йские классы два ме́сяца, я у́знала, что мой кита́йский о́чень улу́чшился, осо́бенно в слу́шании и говоре́нии. Тепе́рь я начина́ю на́дивляться этой кита́йской наста́внице. Из-за неё́ мы до́лжны пра́ктиковать кита́йский ка́ждый день.
reading_paragraphs: Ya ne vidéla teb́ya dól'gíy vré́mya! Kak u teb́ya delá?

Ya sámyy zányatyy v étu vesnú. Vdobávok k rabótе, ya tákzhe dóljna brat' kitáyskiye klássy. Nash kitáyskiy klass néskol'ko trúdnыy, potómu chto nastávnitsa govárit líshe na kitáyskom, a ne na anglíyskom. Ponachálu my dúmali, chto oná ne govórit na anglíyskom, no potóm my uználі, chto yéy anglíyskiy óchen' khoróshiy, no oná yego ne govórit. Odnáko, poslé togo kak ya brála kitáyskiye klássy dvá mé́s’yatsa, ya uznála, chto moy kitáyskiy óchen' ulúchshílsya, osobénno v slúshánьi i govorení. Tépér' ya nachináyu nádívlít'sya étyy kitáyskoy nastávnitsе. Íz-za néy my dóljny praktíkovat' kitáyskiy kázhdyy dén'.
